blocks.summary: Problem, world-model motivation, SimDist definition, freeze-and-adapt recipe, headline claims.
Adaptation from mixed-quality data, world models vs end-to-end policies, coverage question, simulation as bootstrap, ranking insight, SimDist contributions.
Real-world RL, physics-based adaptation, generative video world models, and how SimDist differs.
POMDP formulation, discounted return objective, Assumption 1 (privileged simulator).
Eq. (1): encoder, history encoder, latent dynamics, reward, value, base policy heads.
MPPI return computation and base-policy warm-starting.
Planner demands beyond expert manifold; deliberate sub-optimal action injection; expert policy, checkpoints, and V^e.

blocks.section: IV-A. Diverse Trajectories and Dense Supervision
blocks.summary: Policy mixing plus action perturbations produce D_sim with privileged rewards and expert-value targets.
Pretraining loop over D_sim segments; iterative real-world finetuning with all heads frozen except f_theta.
Eq. (2): latent-dynamics, reward, value, and expert-masked BC terms; stop-grad targets; no TD learning.
Why pixel reconstruction is unnecessary and can hurt sim-to-real transfer.
Task structure invariance; freeze encoder/reward/value, finetune only dynamics; off-policy data support.
Eq. (3): supervised latent prediction loss with frozen encoder anchoring.
Collect-then-finetune loop; bootstrapping offloaded to simulation.
Minimal history representation, chunked T-step prediction, sequence-to-sequence reward/value transformers.
UR5e setup, Peg Insertion and Table Leg (Narrow/Wide); Unitree Go2 setup, Slippery Slope and Foam.
SimDist and SimDist+BC variants; RLPD, IQL, SGFT-SAC, Diffusion Policy, pi-0.5 baselines and protocols.
About 2x over baselines, monotonic progress, narrow-to-wide gap widening, throughput gains.
Value transfer (Fig. 5), latent reconstructions (Fig. 9), dynamics loss 0.076 to 0.019, planning reshaping (Fig. 8).
Unfreezing encoder/value failures; data scale/diversity; MLP vs transformer heads; reconstruction loss.
Contributions and limitations: value saturation cap, no internet-scale video, simulation coverage dependence.
Thanks and funding (NASA 80NSSC23K1192, FieldAI).
59 bibliography entries preserved in the source PDF, not translated entry by entry.
Algorithm 2: per-environment noise covariance, noise intervals, checkpoint assignment, V^e queries, expert flags.
Expert reuse from Yin et al. 2026, data-generation parameters, ResNet-18 encoder, training schedule, MPPI parameters (Tables II-III).
PPO/IsaacLab expert, domain randomization (Tables IV-VI), architecture (Fig. 11, Table VII), training cost, MPPI (Table VIII), detailed results (Table IX).
Separately pretrained models, identical planning hyperparameters, 1080 quadruped evaluation environments (Table X).
